_comment: Global Events catalog (Paepay/tsps#65, platform spec Paepay/PaeScape_Realms#110). Costs and durations are platform-owned: null here means the platform must send the purchased duration on activation. Balance values are the ones the issues state; anything unspecified is a named knob, not invented at a call site.

events.name: Berserker
events.description: Your melee attacks always hit NPCs, through every defensive bonus and protection prayer. PvM only.
events.summary: Melee attacks have 100% accuracy through defensive bonuses and protection prayers.

events.name: Deadeye
events.description: Your ranged attacks always hit NPCs, through every defensive bonus and protection prayer. PvM only.
events.summary: Ranged attacks have 100% accuracy through defensive bonuses and protection prayers.

events.name: Mystique
events.description: Your magic attacks always hit NPCs, through every defensive bonus and protection prayer. PvM only.
events.summary: Magic attacks have 100% accuracy through defensive bonuses and protection prayers.

events.name: Onslaught
events.description: Your maximum hit against NPCs is increased by 50% in every combat style. PvM only.
events.summary: 50% more maximum hit in every combat style against NPCs.

events.name: Bloodthirst
events.description: Your attacks in every combat style have a 1-in-4 chance to heal you for 30% of the damage they deal. PvM only.
events.summary: Blood Fury mechanics for every combat style against NPCs.

events.name: Endless Harvest
events.description: Resources you gather go straight to your bank, even when your inventory is full.
events.summary: Gathered resources go directly to your bank.

events.name: Abundance
events.description: Every gathered resource is doubled, and you gain the experience for the extra resource.
events.summary: Double every gathered resource, with XP for the extra resources.

events.name: Infernal Gathering
events.description: Logs you chop burn for Firemaking XP, ore you mine smelts into bars for Smithing XP, and fish you catch cook for Cooking XP.
events.summary: Automatically burn logs, smelt ore and cook fish as they are gathered.

events.name: Production Master
events.description: Runecrafting, Smithing, Crafting, Fletching, Herblore, Cooking and Firemaking process the whole eligible inventory in one cycle.
events.summary: Process an entire inventory in one production cycle.

events.name: Trickster
events.description: Eligible Thieving and Hunter actions always succeed, pickpocketing repeats automatically, and a temporary Sage's greaves can be claimed.
events.summary: 100% success for eligible Thieving and Hunter actions, automatic pickpocketing, plus temporary Sage's greaves.

events.name: Rags to Riches
events.description: Eligible unique drops from NPCs, bosses, raids and skilling encounters are 10% more likely.
events.summary: Multiplies eligible unique drop chances by 1.1 across NPCs, bosses, raids and skilling encounters.

events.name: Accelerate
events.description: Every experience gain is doubled, from combat, skilling, quests, lamps and minigames.

events.name: Prodigy
events.description: All skills are raised by 12 levels and refreshed every tick. Hitpoints and Prayer are excluded.
events.summary: +12 visible levels in every skill except Hitpoints and Prayer, refreshed each tick.

events.name: Banker's Note
events.description: A temporary Banker's note can be claimed. Use an item on it to note or un-note it anywhere.
events.summary: Access to a temporary Banker's Note that works anywhere.

events.name: Master's Arsenal
events.description: Borrow one temporary Best-in-Slot weapon or tool at a time. It needs no charges, ammo or runes and waives its equipment skill requirement, but quest, resource and activity requirements still apply. PvP damage is disabled.
events.summary: Borrow temporary Best-in-Slot weapons and tools with no charges required.

items._comment: `eventItemId` is the stable 1,000,000+ contract id recorded in the item binding. The 317 wire protocol still encodes item ids in 16 bits, so the granted copy uses `itemId` (a real or cache-safe id) and the binding carries the virtual id; see docs/global-events.md.

messages.slotBusy: A {category} event is already running on this world.
messages.expired: A temporary Global Event item you were carrying expired and has been removed.
messages.combatLock: You can't do that in combat or for a few seconds after it.
messages.disabled: You have turned the effects of that event off. Enable them in the Events panel first.
messages.claimOnce: You already have that temporary item.
messages.noRoom: You don't have enough inventory space for that.
messages.claimNotActive: That event is not active on this world.
messages.claimDisabled: Turn that event's effects on in the Events panel before claiming.
messages.claimTrickster: You need Trickster active to claim the Sage's greaves.
messages.claimArsenal: Choose a Master's Arsenal item to borrow.
messages.tokenUnavailable: The PaeScape platform is unavailable right now. Nothing was spent.
messages.tokenAccountUnlinked: Your character is not linked to a PaeScape account yet.
messages.tokenNone: You don't have a {event} token. Buy one with PaePoints in the Store on the PaeScape website.
messages.tokenActivated: {event} activated for {minutes} minutes. One event token was spent.
messages.tokenNoDuration: {event} does not have a configured duration yet; nothing was spent.
messages.tokenNotMember: That account is not a member of this world.
messages.tokenBadRequest: The platform could not process that activation.
messages.tokenPreferenceFailed: Your event preference could not be saved. Nothing else changed.
messages.tokenPending: An activation for that event is already in progress.
messages.eventAlreadyRunning: That category already has an event running.
messages.adminPlatformOnly: Global Events are activated and stopped on the PaeScape platform; this world only applies them.

platform._comment: Platform-owned contract (PaeScape_Realms#110). The platform is the only writer of activations, token balances and account preferences; the world re-reads world state and account state and never reserves or consumes a token itself.
